After that, inspect the benchmark table and case studies, but do not over-index on rank. Pay more attention to task coverage, which tasks require long-horizon recovery, which rely on evidence verification, and whether the paper distinguishes single-step tool use from multi-stage workflows.

Finally, read the analysis of the 769 development records. The role taxonomy, the way feasibility is judged, and the evidence behind the “agent proposes, human selects” pattern are the most useful parts if you care about self-improvement loops.

A quick skim takes about 30-40 minutes. A serious read requires checking appendices, benchmark release details, and any accompanying system card.112:T560,ReSkill decomposes repair into explicit components. Given a failed rollout, a frozen language model generates a set of failure hypotheses, a set of candidate local patches, and a coverage matrix indicating which hypotheses each patch addresses. The outer repair procedure maintains weights over active hypotheses, selects a patch by weighted coverage, applies it to the external skill set, and retests the edited skill set in the environment. If the retest still fails, the new failed trajectory is used to update the hypothesis set and their weights for the next round.

Two design choices matter. First, model weights remain frozen throughout; only the external skill set is edited. That makes repairs local, inspectable, and reversible. Second, repair state is maintained across rounds in structured form rather than compressed into a fresh natural-language reflection each time. This separates diagnosis, patch generation, patch selection, and feedback integration, reducing the noise that comes from asking the model to do all of them in one generation.

Relative to one-shot reflection methods such as Reflexion-style repair, ReSkill behaves more like an explicit credit-assignment loop over hypotheses and edits. The language model proposes structured repair factors, but the outer procedure decides which local edit to trust based on coverage and environment feedback.113:T444,The evaluation uses two interactive settings: ALFWorld for grounded household interaction and TextCraft from AgentGym for symbolic crafting. Together they form six benchmark–model combinations. Under fixed repair budgets, ReSkill improves final repair success by an average of 3.7 and 3.3 percentage points over two competitive repair baselines. The gains are moderate, but meaningful in a budgeted multi-round repair setting, where avoiding wasted edits matters.

From the analysis, the method helps most when failures have multiple plausible causes and when the first repair attempt reveals a new failure mode that should change which hypotheses are prioritized next. Because model weights are unchanged, the improvements are better interpreted as evidence for the repair procedure itself rather than for additional learned capability.

The limitations are also clear. The gains are not large, and the environments are still relatively controlled. Whether the same framework scales to more open-ended tool-use agents, coding agents, or real software environments remains an open question.114:T55d,SkillLift formulates skill evolution as a bilevel optimization problem. The upper level learns a rubric that matches oracle preferences over skills. The lower level optimizes a population of skills under that rubric. The central claim is that ranking is a smoother and cheaper target than absolute score prediction: it is enough to know which skill is better, not to estimate exact utility.

The optimization alternates between two phases. In the skill-update phase, the rubric is fixed and used as a cheap surrogate evaluator. It provides dense, structured feedback for revising candidate skills. In the rubric-update phase, the skill population is fixed and the oracle is called only to realign the rubric-induced ranking with the oracle ranking. This separates expensive evaluation from frequent search steps.

A practical point the paper emphasizes is oracle complexity. Many prior methods effectively pay O(LT) oracle cost, where L is the number of evolution rounds and T is the number of inner optimization epochs. SkillLift aims for O(L): the oracle is used for periodic realignment, while most search happens in the learned rubric space. The paper also positions the rubric as a structured evaluation space rather than a single scalar reward model, which matters because skill editing benefits from interpretable dimensions of feedback rather than one opaque score.115:T539,The paper starts with a pilot study on 10 WildClawBench tasks, 10 evolution rounds, and 3 rollout seeds per skill. The point of this study is diagnostic: direct skill optimization shows large best–worst gaps throughout training, indicating high variance and poor scaling, while oracle token cost dominates total compute and keeps growing.

The main experiments cover two complex agent benchmarks. The headline result in the paper is that SkillLift outperforms existing auto-skill evolution baselines even when those baselines are given a 2x larger token budget. It also reaches target performance with 40% to 70% lower token cost. The important takeaway is not only lower cost, but a better search regime: converting sparse oracle outcomes into an aligned rubric changes the efficiency frontier of skill improvement.

The most informative ablations are the conceptual ones: whether ranking targets are more stable than absolute-score targets, whether alternating optimization beats direct end-to-end skill revision, and whether dense rubric feedback reduces failure-patching behavior. Those are the experiments to inspect closely. If the full paper reports rubric–oracle rank correlation, sensitivity to oracle refresh frequency, or diversity of the skill population, those would be especially useful signals for judging scalability.116:T518,The central thesis is “substrate inversion” with two structural commitments:
- A single agent-native reasoning surface: the agent reads and reasons over one shared substrate expressed in a form the LLM can consume in one pass (Markdown is presented as a pragmatic instantiation, not a final primitive).
- Schema translation isolated at the action boundary: a Sync Agent (or boundary layer) compiles legacy typed data into the substrate and translates decisions back into executable actions, preventing repeated schema crossings during reasoning.
Two mechanisms justify why these commitments matter:
1) Context-bandwidth asymmetry: LLMs can ingest large, relationally rich prose in one forward pass, while field-by-field typed access strips relations at each schema boundary, forcing the model to reconstruct relational context in working memory.
2) Cross-loop coupling: action, skill, and policy improvement loops compound only if they share the same substrate; otherwise improvements remain siloed across incompatible representations.
Operationally, the paper sketches a four-layer framework (Data/Knowledge/Intelligence/Governance), introduces per-skill trust gradients, and discusses how safety risks (notably indirect prompt injection) are reshaped rather than eliminated by the substrate choice.117:T8e7,LGM 的方法由三段组成，逻辑比较完整。

第一段是 latent memory disentanglement。作者不直接对原始文本建图，而是先用 backbone LM 的多层 hidden states 表示每条历史 interaction 和当前 query，再把这些 dense representation 映射到共享低维空间。之后引入 sparse autoencoder，把稠密表征分解成稀疏概念激活。这样做的意图有两层：一是把显式偏好和隐式行为线索投到同一概念坐标系里，便于后续关联；二是用稀疏性降低噪声和混叠，让每条记忆不再只能作为整段文本被检索，而是能以概念级别参与组合。

第二段是 query-conditioned latent graph construction。这是和 GraphRAG 最不同的地方。LGM 不维护一个固定全局图，而是根据当前 query 与 memory 的概念共激活情况，动态构造潜图并决定边权。也就是说，同一批历史记忆在不同 query 下会形成不同的连接拓扑。随后作者用 relational GNN 在这个激活子图上做消息传播，把分散在多条历史中的弱证据聚合成紧凑 graph state，同时得到节点级 relevance score。这里的 neuro-symbolic 味道主要体现在：symbolic 的部分是概念节点和关系结构，neural 的部分是概念抽取、边权生成和图上传播都可微。

第三段是 graph-conditioned reasoning。传播后的 latent graph state 不直接作为最终答案，而是被映射成一小组 memory prefix tokens，用来条件化下游生成。这样可以避免把大量原始历史文本重新塞回上下文。为了防止 latent 推理脱离事实，作者又加了 evidence-reconstruction objective，要求压缩后的状态仍能重建或对齐支持性证据，抑制多步传播中的 information collapse。全文强调 selection、association、aggregation、utilization 这几个阶段是端到端联合优化的，而不是先检索、再建图、再生成的松耦合流水线。

和常见 RAG 相比，LGM 的关键差异不是“多了个图”，而是把图构造从文本空间移到了 query-conditioned latent concept space；和静态 GraphRAG 相比，它的图不是预先固定的；和单纯 memory summarization 相比，它保留了可追溯的节点相关性和证据重建约束。118:T40f,The paper addresses long-term memory use in personalized agents, but not through the usual prompt replay or retrieval-only framing. Its central question is whether long interaction histories can be disentangled and organized in latent space before generation. The authors argue that existing approaches break down in two ways. Flat retrieval scores memory fragments independently and misses distributed evidence across sessions. Structured memory systems such as GraphRAG build graphs, but those graphs are usually query-agnostic and static, so they cannot adapt relations to the current request. Raw textual memories are also entangled by nature: one interaction may mix topic, preference, sentiment, and behavioral cues. Replaying all of this at the text level is expensive, noisy, and hard on context length and KV cache. The core problem is therefore how to perform query-aware memory disentanglement and relational reasoning without repeatedly replaying the full textual history, while still staying faithful to the original evidence.119:T96b,LGM consists of three tightly connected stages.

The first is latent memory disentanglement. Instead of building structure directly over raw text, the method extracts multi-layer hidden states from a backbone LM for each historical interaction and for the current query, then maps them into a shared low-dimensional space. A sparse autoencoder is applied to decompose these dense representations into sparse concept activations. This serves two purposes: it places explicit preferences and implicit behavioral evidence into a common concept space, and it reduces entanglement so that memories can participate at the concept level rather than only as whole text chunks.

The second stage is query-conditioned latent graph construction, which is the main departure from GraphRAG. LGM does not maintain one persistent global graph. Instead, it dynamically constructs a latent graph based on concept co-activation between the query and the memory pool, with edge weights determined on demand. The same historical memory bank can therefore induce different graph topologies for different queries. A relational GNN then propagates signals over the activated subgraph, aggregating weak clues scattered across sessions into a compact graph state and producing node-level relevance scores. The neuro-symbolic aspect comes from combining symbolic structure at the concept-and-relation level with differentiable concept extraction, edge formation, and message passing.

The third stage is graph-conditioned reasoning. The resulting latent graph state is mapped into a compact set of memory prefix tokens that condition downstream generation, avoiding raw-text replay. To keep latent reasoning anchored to actual evidence, the model adds an evidence-reconstruction objective, which penalizes information loss and helps prevent collapse during multi-step propagation. The paper emphasizes that memory selection, association, aggregation, and utilization are optimized end to end rather than as a loosely coupled retrieve-then-generate pipeline.

Compared with standard RAG, the key difference is not merely adding a graph, but moving graph construction from text space into a query-conditioned latent concept space. Compared with static GraphRAG, the graph is dynamic. Compared with memory summarization, the method preserves node relevance and introduces an explicit faithfulness constraint through evidence reconstruction.11a:T5a5,The experiments cover PersonaMem, PrefEval, and the implicit-preference split of PersonaMem-v2, using Qwen2.5-7B, Gemma3-4B, and Qwen3-4B as backbones. The main result is that LGM achieves the best average accuracy under the main backbone settings, with the largest gains on implicit-preference and long-context cases. That pattern is consistent with the method: these are exactly the settings where success depends on combining weak evidence distributed across sessions rather than retrieving one obvious memory fragment.

The paper also stresses efficiency. Relative to methods that rely on repeated text replay or multiple LM calls over structured memories, LGM sits on a favorable frontier in LM calls, token usage, and time to first token. In other words, the gains are not presented as a pure compute-for-accuracy trade.

From the full-text description, the ablations likely test the contribution of each module. Removing the sparse autoencoder should make the concept space noisier and hurt implicit preference inference. Replacing the dynamic graph with a static one should weaken multi-hop evidence integration. Removing the evidence-reconstruction objective should make latent propagation drift and reduce faithfulness. The excerpt provided does not include the full numeric tables, so exact percentages should not be fabricated, but the paper clearly positions itself around a dual objective: higher accuracy and lower inference cost.11b:T4c0,This is a skim paper. The value is less in the equations and more in how the problem is reframed. Start with the introduction and problem formulation to understand why the authors see text-level long-term memory handling as a source of context saturation, KV-cache growth, and distraction from irrelevant text. Then read the method figure and trace the pipeline: hidden states to sparse concepts, then to a query-conditioned latent graph, then to memory prefix tokens.

If time is limited, focus on two parts. First, the latent graph construction section, because that is where the paper differs most clearly from GraphRAG. Three follow-up questions are worth asking. How stable is the learned concept space across backbones? Does the memory-prefix interface limit generation expressivity? And could this kind of latent memory module be learned jointly during pretraining rather than attached only at the agent or post-training stage?11c:T40d,The proposed Compute-Value Audit decomposes test-time scaling into four ordered gates: opportunity, state confidence, action value, and entry fee. Opportunity asks whether better samples exist in the fixed pool. State asks whether observable signals are informative. Action asks whether using those signals improves the target metric. Entry fee accounts for the full cost of generation and verification. The audit fixes the complete candidate budget and requires selectors to score the same pool, avoiding hidden generation or unfair cache reuse. The paper also introduces a Verifier-Quality Law using a minimal Gaussian model, showing that recovered headroom is directly governed by the correlation between verifier score and target quality. Tested deployable signals include Proprio, a one-step flow residual under controlled latent perturbations; cycle energy, which re-noises a latent and integrates it back to measure consistency; and PM, a memory-based reranker that uses legal history without updating the world model or verifier.11d:T40c,The paper is a critical review rather than a new modeling method. It separates three notions. The allocation problem is the decision of how to divide build-time and run-time resources under cost and deployment constraints. A scaling result measures how quality changes as one resource is varied while other settings are fixed. An allocation claim says that one budget split is better than another. The paper argues that many studies establish the second but not the third. It identifies three recurring mismatches: success is counted before a returned answer is selected, the experiment uses information unavailable at deployment time, and important costs are omitted. Examples include reporting coverage over many sampled answers instead of returned-answer accuracy, using answer keys or oracle difficulty estimates, and counting only generation FLOPs while ignoring verifier training, retrieval, latency, or dollar costs. 重复时已经出现清晰退化；到 32×32 重复时，MoE 会失去相对 dense 的性能优势。第二，过拟合随稀疏度增强而加重，并且退化模式更接近由 total parameters 决定，而不是由 active parameters 决定。这一点对 MoE scaling 很关键，因为 active FLOPs 相同的模型，total parameter count t)。这一步的动机是：黑盒拿不到softmax概率，但可以用“采样分布”近似模型的条件分布。\n\n2）Sequence-level likelihood estimator：将word级概率按链式法则聚合为序列对数似然的估计（平均log-likelihood形式），得到一个可用于阈值判别的membership Standard practice treats it as a scalar penalty on the softmax log-normalizer, mainly used to keep logits bounded and reduce mixed-precision instability. The paper argues that this view misses the operative object: the gradient injected at the logit boundary. Once transported through the output projection, tied embeddings, top-k routing, fused loss implementations, and optimizer state, this gradient can have effects that are not predicted by the reported scalar Z-loss curve.","importance":"The main value for pretraining is a diagnostic framework for a stability regularizer that is already used in large-scale LM and MoE training. The contribution is not a universal coefficient or a single better Z-loss variant. It is a way to separate source amplitude, source shape, output-to-hidden gain, pathway coupling, and router effective scale. This matters because reducing log Z is not the same as reducing update tails or improving static loss-scale headroom. For large pretraining runs, the paper points to a practical rule: auxiliary stability losses should be audited at the level of backward sources and optimizer-facing updates, not only by their forward scalar values.","technical_approach":"$1d","experiments":"The empirical study uses pretrained GPT-2-family models: GPT-2, DistilGPT-2, GPT-2 Medium, and GPT-2 Large, roughly 124M, 82M, 355M, and 774M parameters. The experiments include matched dense continued pretraining, high-coefficient stress sweeps without relying on clipping to hide failures, static mixed-precision endpoint tests, low-rank output-to-hidden gain spectral audits, optimizer-facing update audits, audits of a row-wise fused CE+Z-loss Triton GPU kernel, and end-to-end top-k MoE language-model training. The main empirical message is that low-coefficient Z-loss settings can preserve validation perplexity, but stress regimes reveal model- and regime-dependent trade-offs among validation quality, update tails, Adam-state pressure, and mixed-precision headroom. Muon does not simply apply the raw gradient; it forms a momentum matrix and then approximately orthogonalizes it. The paper asks whether structured finite-difference measurements can provide a useful substitute for that matrix.","importance":"Its direct impact on large-scale LLM pretraining is limited, but it is useful for understanding the geometry of Muon-like optimizers. Muon has been used in multi-billion-parameter language model training, and this work highlights an important caveat: the polar factor removes singular values and keeps singular directions. Therefore, a low-rank gradient surrogate that looks accurate in a standard matrix norm may still induce a poor orthogonalized update if small singular directions are wrong.","technical_approach":"The method uses rank-one perturbations H=uv^T and finite-difference function evaluations to estimate directional information for a matrix parameter W. The paper studies four variants. Full entrywise recovery reconstructs the gradient by coordinate finite differences and costs O(mn) measurements. Random low-rank surrogates use random rank-one probes to reduce the number of queries, at the cost of noisier update directions. Basis-aligned rank-one probing uses coordinate-aligned probes; exhaustive probing is equivalent to coordinate finite differences up to positive scaling before ideal polar orthogonalization. Direct structured search avoids full gradient reconstruction and searches directly over structured rank-one update directions. The distinction from generic derivative-free optimization is that the target object is not only a scalar local model, but the orthogonalized Muon update.","experiments":"The experiments cover matrix regression, neural-network training, and CartPole policy optimization. The matrix-regression results show the main trade-off: random rank-one probing can substantially reduce function evaluations, but the resulting Muon update is less accurate than fuller reconstruction. The paper also gives a concrete 4×4 masked quadratic example. Although W has 16 entries, only two entries carry first-order information. Naive central differences require 2mn=32 function evaluations, while using the known mask requires only 4 evaluations. In this example, the initial objective decreases from 5 to 2 after the ideal Muon step. The example also illustrates that Muon maps singular values 3 and 1 to equal-weight singular directions.","reading_guide":"Skim in about 20 minutes. The authors argue that frontier MoE models still have two limitations for live learning: all experts must remain resident, and the expert bank is fixed after training. The proposed direction keeps input-conditioned weights but replaces the static expert bank with a compact generator or hypernetwork that produces weights, adapters, or low-dimensional codes from live data. Facts, instructions, demonstrations, and corrections that would normally be kept in context can instead be compiled into parameter states. The paper is careful to distinguish this from increasing long-term storage capacity; the generator is still bounded by its own parameters. OmniKVQuan","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2609_11582.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CV"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作解决的是 在不同模态上占据不同几何区域，共用一套旋转不能充分均匀化。论文的核心问题不是“能不能量化”，而是“多模态缓存为什么不能直接套文本方法，以及应该如何做最小改动的训练后修正”。","importance":"它对预训练本身不是直接贡献，但对大模型系统和统一多模态建模有现实意义。Omni-LLM 的上下文长度很容易被音视频 token 拉到万级，KV cache 往往比权重更占显存，部署和长上下文推理都会受限。OmniKVQuant的价值在于，它把多模态 KV cache 的统计结构讲清楚了：key 的问题主要是时间局部漂移，value 的问题主要是模态异质几何。这种分解很干净，也说明多模态模型不能简单把单模态压缩技巧平移过去。对做统一多模态预训练的人来说，这篇工作提供了一个有用视角：不同模态在共享 decoder 做低比特量化。这个思路默认整个缓存都能被一个全局参考分布和一套共享旋转较好描述。\n\nOmniKVQuant认为这个假设在 Omni-LLM 上不成立。第一处修正是 temporal range adaptation，针对 key。作者观察到即便经过 Hadamard 旋转，key 坐标分布仍明显偏离目标高斯，而且这种偏离会随时间窗口变化。于是方法不再用全局固定范围，而是在短时间 token group 内，对旋转后的 key 逐坐标做 min-max 缩放，再映射到 codebook。这样做不是重新学习 codebook，而是让同一 codebook 在局部窗口内适配当前缓存的动态范围。这个设计抓住了 key 的局部非平稳性，也尽量保持训练后量化的简单性。\n\n第二处修正是 modality-specific value rotation，针对 value。作者用 PCA 可视化发现音频、视觉、文本 value 分布位于不同区域，共享旋转不能同时把三者都“摊平”。因此他们为不同模态分别校准旋转，使每种模态的 value 在量化前更接近适合 codebook 的几何形态。这里的关键不是复杂建模，而是承认共享 decoder 内部仍保留模态特定几何，并在量化阶段显式利用。\n\n除了量化策略，论文还给了一个 fused Triton decode kernel。实现上不再对缓存中的每个 key 做逆旋转，而是按 FlashAttention 风格的计算顺序，每个 head 只旋转当前 query；对 value 的逆旋转则在 head 输出上做批处理。这样减少了重复旋转和 kernel launch 开销，不需要重建稠密 FP16 cache。这部分更偏系统实现，但对实际可用性很关键。","experiments":"实验主要在 Qwen2.5-Omni 和 Qwen3-Omni 上做。分析实验先证明问题确实存在：在 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B + WorldSense 上，经过 Hadamard 旋转后，key 坐标只保留了 30.40% 的高斯参考方差，Wasserstein-1 距离为 0.778，KS 统计量为 0.449，而且音频和视频比文本偏离更明显。相较之下，value 更接近高斯分布，但其跨模态几何差异明显。这组分析支撑了“key 用时间局部适配，value 用模态专属旋转”的拆分。\n\n主结果方面，作者报告在 Qwen2.5-Omni 的七个音视频 benchmark 上，2-bit KV cache 仍能保留 98.1% 的 FP16 性能，且整体上稳定优于 TurboQuant。摘要没有给出每个 benchmark 的逐项数字，但从全文描述看，优势是跨任务一致的，而不是只在单一数据集上成立。论文也在 Qwen3-Omni 上复现了趋势，说明方法不是绑死在一个模型实现上。\n\n如果从工程角度看，最重要的结论有两个。第一，2-bit 在 Omni-LLM 上不是不可用，但前提是量化策略要尊重多模态缓存结构。第二，训练后方法依然能拿到较高保真度，这意味着不需要重新训练模型就能显著压缩长上下文推理内存。若读全文，建议重点留意 ablation：只做 temporal adaptation、只做 modality-specific rotation、两者同时做时各自贡献有多大；这决定了方法到底是由哪一部分在主导收益。","reading_guide":"泛读建议按“问题分析→方法修正→系统实现→主结果”这个顺序。先看引言和分析表，确认 TurboQuant 在多模态缓存上具体哪里失效，不要只记住一个“多模态更难量化”的泛泛结论。然后看 temporal key drift 和 heterogeneous value Existing KV quantization methods were developed for text-only models and assume a cache distribution that is much more homogeneous than what appears in multimodal decoding. Starting from TurboQuant, the authors identify two concrete failure modes in omni-modal caches: temporal key drift, where key distributions vary across short windows and modalities, and heterogeneous value geometry, where values from different modalities occupy different regions of representation space. The central question is not whether low-bit KV quantization is possible, but why text-era assumptions break in Omni-LLMs and how to fix them without retraining.","importance":"This is more of a systems-and-modeling interface paper than a pretraining recipe paper, but it matters for unified multimodal models. 之后去缩放输出；前者直接重分配注意力质量，梯度信号更对齐“选谁”。\n  2) gate 激活要跨 block 归一化（如对 block 分数做 softmax），让 gate 表达相对重要性并保持可校准，而不是无界打分。\n  3) gate 保持连续值，不在训练时坍缩成二值 Top-K 指示；这样不仅学“选中/不选中”，还学“优先级/相对权重”，梯度更稳定。\n  4) The target setting is single-user, edge-style inference, where every generated token normally pays full-layer cost even though many tokens may already be determined at intermediate layers. Two practical obstacles frame the problem: exit decisions must be cheap enough to preserve savings, and early-exited tokens leave missing upper-layer KV states for future attention. This has implications for how we think about layerwise representation formation during pretraining, whether intermediate states should be made more directly usable, and how domain specialization appears inside a general model. In a standard dense model, FFN neurons and attention heads or KV groups can be permuted without changing the model output up to numerical noise. The paper defines calibration-based affinity scores between KV groups and FFN neurons, and between FFN neurons and the next layer's KV groups. Principal-angle analysis shows that queries from think, act, tool, and others phases occupy distinguishable subspaces. AgentKV therefore maintains a small query buffer for each phase and scores candidate keys against the union of phase-specific representatives. The implementation is integrated into a persistent multi-turn serving path, with compressed KV state reused across turns, online KV-page compaction, and allocator-level reuse to reduce memory-copy and allocation overhead.","experiments":"The evaluation spans two models, six task domains, and three KV budgets. P(S|X)=∏t πθ(at|a<t,X)。候选集合除了原始视觉 token，还加入一个 STOP 动作 ∅。策略每一步选择一个 token，或在某一步选择 STOP 并结束，因此最终保留数量 K 不再是外部超参数，而是输入自适应的结果。\n\n策略网络实现为 pointer-style decoder，并且是 cross-modal 的：选择决策不仅看视觉 token，也看文本指令和已选历史。这样做的原因很直接。若已经选中过一个交通标志 patch，附近高度相似的 patch 边际价值就会下降；若问题问的是街道名称，后续更该补充文字区域而不是继续选轮廓相似的背景 token。这个“条件边际价值”是一步式 top-K 很难表达的。\n\n训练难点在于离散选择不可导。作者提出一个 trajectory-aware 的 differentiable The GPU memory system consists of a primary tier of high-bandwidth memory (HBM) and a secondary tier of host memory connected via CPU-to-GPU interconnect. Existing acceleration methods usually rely on fixed block sizes or fixed confidence thresholds, which implicitly assume roughly uniform token difficulty across positions. The paper argues that this assumption is wrong: token difficulty is highly heterogeneous, and tokens with similar uncertainty often cluster together. (autoe","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-09-14T18:58:09Z","category_id":"efficient","cover_url":"/covers/2609_16229.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.LG","cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是 LLM 机器遗忘里一个很难绕开的矛盾：如果用改权重的方式去“删知识”，往往会把目标知识附近的正常能力一起伤到；但如果改得轻，知识又会在攻击提示、软提示、后续微调，甚至量化后重新冒出来。论文把问题重述为“运行时访问控制”而不是“参数层面的永久擦除”：不去要求一次全局参数更新同时兼顾遗忘和保留，而是在生成过程中识别模型何时进入与待遗忘知识相关的内部状态，只在这些状态上做局部干预。这样，遗忘与保留不再被绑在同一组权重更新上。","importance":"对预训练和基座模型研究的意义不在于它提出了新的训练 ARIA：Autoencoder-gated Inference-time Unlearning。整体分三步。第一步，作者先在通用语料上预训练 sparse autoencoder，把基座模型若干层的激活分解成稀疏 latent feature。这里选 SAE 而不是直接用原始 hidden state，原因是 SAE latent 更稀疏、更可解释，也更适合后面训练一个线性检测头；如果直接在 dense hidden state 上做检测，虽然也可能有效，但触发依据会更难审计，且更容易把很多无关方向混在一起。第二步，用 forget/retain 相关轨迹在 SAE latent 空间里训练一个轻量的稀疏线性 detector，判断当前生成状态是否进入“与待遗忘知识相关”的区域。这个 detector 不是对输入 prompt 做分类，而是对生成过程中的状态做逐步判别，因此它能捕捉中间推理、改写、旁敲侧击等更隐蔽的泄露路径。第三步，在推理时做 detector-gated policy intervention：当 detector 未触发时，完全沿用原模型分布；当 detector 触发时，对 next-token policy 做抑制式干预，阻断目标知识暴露。论文强调这种设计与权重编辑的区别：权重编辑是全局、静态、一次性的；ARIA 是局部、条件化、按状态触发的。理论部分给出一个关键结论，即遗忘泄露和保留损伤都受 detector 的误报/漏报率控制。直观上，漏报会让该拦截的状态漏过去，形成 forget leakage；误报会把本来正常的状态也拦住，形成 retain degradation。这个分解很重要，因为它把问题从“如何找到完美的权重更新”转成“如何学到更准的状态检测器”。论文还利用 detector 的稀疏性做 feature-level case study，发现部分 retain 下降并不是知识本身被误伤，而是 unlearning 数据里的回答风格偏差被 detector 学进去了，这一点对 benchmark 构造很有提醒意义。","experiments":"实验覆盖三个常见遗忘基准：TOFU、R-TOFU、WMDP，并在两类模型上验证：一个是 thinking model DeepSeek-R1-1.5B，一个是 instruction model Gemma-3-1B-it。作者把 ARIA 与主流 weight-based unlearning 方法做对比，结论是 forget-retain trade-off 更好，而且在更强攻击下更稳。摘要和引言里给出的代表性结果是：在 WMDP-cyber 上，ARIA 能把 forget-set accuracy 压到所有对比方法之下，同时把 MMLU 控制在相对原模型约 1% 的下降内。这个结果说明它不是靠大面积降能力来“假装遗忘”。更关键的是鲁棒性评估。作者专门设计了三类 post-unlearning adversarial Weight sharing makes these models parameter-efficient, but autoregressive decoding repeatedly reloads the same recurrent block stack for every token, so latency becomes memory-bandwidth bound. Its relevance to foundation-model research is practical: long-context capability is constrained not only by model architecture and training data, but also by the memory traffic pattern during decoding. This removes global draft and verify phases. The second component is a lightweight online scheduler. It tracks per-request acceptance behavior and uses a batch-aware draft-to-verify cost ratio to decide whether each request should keep drafting or verify in the next model forward. The third component is an intra-draft refresh mechanism. During drafting, a selected refresh layer performs full attention and updates the partial KV set for the next token, exploiting the correlation of attention patterns across layers and neighboring tokens. Compared with MagicDec and Vegas, the main shift is from synchronized batch-level speculation to per-request asynchronous speculation, with an additional mechanism to reduce stale-context effects during long drafts.","experiments":"The paper evaluates ASPIRE on three models and five workloads. This explains why synchronized batched speculation leaves performance on the table. Pruning entire experts reduces the persistent memory footprint and composes with quantization. In an MoE layer, the router selects the top-K experts for each token and combines their outputs with normalized gate weights. When an expert is removed, the router backfills with the next-highest-logit expert and renormalizes the gates. HOPE chooses the prune set that minimizes an upper bound on the resulting layer-output error. During calibration, it records expert usage and pairwise interaction terms, building an E-by-E interaction matrix for each layer. task-level similarity，也让负例更自然，而不是随机负采样。\n\n标签体系分成三个独立维度：Task、Problem、Method，分别对应应用目标、核心研究挑战、技术路径。作者强调这三个维度是固定 ground truth，而不是让模型自由发挥后再做模糊匹配。这样做的好处是，模型在哪个维度误判可以被明确定位。\n\n评测协议比普通 benchmark 更严格。模型不仅要判断某个维度是否重叠，还要给出 verbatim evidence span。之后进入三级级联诊断：先检查 per-dimension correctness，再检查 evidence hallucination，最后检查 reasoning mismatch。只有三关都通过，才计入 Verified F1。这个指标的含义是“答对且理由对”，而不是只看最终标签是否碰巧正确。除此之外，数据里还有 50 个 multi-paper grouping set，用来测模型能否在多篇相关工作之间做更结构化的 novelty grouping，而不只是二元比较。","experiments":"实验覆盖 18 个 LLM。论文的主结论不是某个模型分数多高，而是 failure mode 很一致：即便最终 overlap judgment 是对的，模型也经常给出捏造证据，或者证据与结论在逻辑上脱节；而且这种失败在 task、problem、method 三个维度上的分布差异很大。正文里还指出，ICLR 来源和 survey 来源的样本分布不同，前者更偏 method/problem，后者更偏 task，这使得 benchmark 能揭示模型在不同 novelty 的输出与人工标签对齐，比较整体一致性、错误类型和跨攻击族的稳定性。\n\n从全文看，作者想说明的不是某个 evaluator 在所有意义上都最好，而是不同 evaluator 实际编码了不同的 jailbreak 成功定义。比如有的更偏向“是否产生了有害内容”，有的更偏向“是否真正完成了有害请求”，有的对表面顺从但内容空洞的回答更敏感，有的则容易被 prompt 结构或措辞干扰。JADES 的优势来自把请求拆成加权子问题后再评分，这减少了整体式判断时常见的表面线索干扰；StrongReject 的优势来自 rubric 化，能把模糊的整体判断拆成更可控的维度；HarmBench 作为专用分类器，在某些设置下仍然很稳，但它的定义空间更固定。","experiments":"实验使用两个带人工标注的数据集：JailbreakQR 和 JailMeter-Eva，并以人工判断作为参照。作者比较六个 evaluator 与人工标签的一致性，同时分析不同攻击家族下的表现变化。核心结论是：JADES 整体表现最好，HarmBench 和 StrongReject 也较稳定；其余方法在某些设置下会出现更明显的偏差或跨数据集波动。\n\n论文的一个重要贡献是误差分析，而不只是报一个 aggregate score。作者展示了 evaluator 之间的分歧并非噪声，而是源于定义差异：有些方法会把“带有有害语气但没有真正给出可执行内容”的回答判成成功；有些方法则会漏掉“语言温和但实质完成请求”的回答。对跨攻击家族的分析也说明，某些 evaluator 在熟悉的攻击分布上表现尚可，但换一种 jailbreak 风格后稳定性下降。\n\n摘要里没有给出完整数值，正文的重点也不是追求极小的百分点差异，而是建立统一比较框架。对读者更有用的信息是排名和误差模式：JADES 最接近人工，HarmBench/StrongReject 是较稳的次优选择，而 evaluator 选择本身足以改变攻击成功率的结论。","reading_guide":"泛读建议先看 Introduction 和 regression 在 grouped cross-validation 下做分类。如果这样一个极简分类器都能显著高于随机水平，就说明 benchmark 的答案写法本身泄漏了标签信息。\n\n第二部分是 Audit-Prune。它不是重新生成数据，也不是训练复杂判别器，而是用前面的审计器给每个样本对打分，识别最强化泄漏模式的 question-answer pairs，再逐步删掉这些 pair，直到泄漏降到目标阈值。作者强调两个设计点：一是特征可解释，因此知道删掉的是哪类偏差；二是目标不是把数据变小，而是在控制泄漏的同时尽量保留 benchmark 的区分能力和模型排序稳定性。\n\n论文还把这套方法和 AFLite 做了比较。AFLite 用 embedding 上的可预测性来过滤样本，适合一般 artifact 清洗，但特征不透明，也不保证过滤掉的是“与任务无关”的信息。Audit-Prune 则更像定向手术：先明确只审计那些肯定不该决定标签的表层特征，再按阈值清洗。这种思路对高风险 benchmark 更合适，因为你知道自己在防什么。\n\n另一个值得注意的点是，作者不只审计 TruthfulQA，还把同一套 Surface6 扩展到另外 13 个 benchmark。也就是说，他们主张的不是“TruthfulQA 有问题”，而是 paired binary-choice benchmark 普遍需要做 surface leakage audit。","experiments":"核心结果很直接。对 TruthfulQA binary-choice，仅用六个表层特征的 logistic classifier，在 grouped-CV Surface6 审计下几乎回到随机水平，AUC 为 0.528，p=0.048。更关键的是，作者声称这个清洗版仍能以接近原始全集的水平评估 truthfulness，同时在对抗设置下更不容易被表层策略欺骗。这里的实验重点不是绝对分数，而是三件事：泄漏是否下降、模型排序是否保留、对抗脆弱性是否减轻。\n\n从全文脉络看，作者还做了与 AFLite 的直接比较，以及在 SNLI/MultiNLI 分钟。\n\n阅读时建议抓住四个判断点。第一，六个特征到底有多“无害”；如果特征本身偷偷编码了 truthfulness，结论就会变弱。第二，为什么要用 grouped cross-validation，而不是普通随机切分；这关系到是否存在同题泄漏。第三，删样本后 benchmark 是否仍保留足够覆盖度和模型排序稳定性。第四，Audit-Prune 更适合离线评测集清洗，还是也能迁移到训练数据和偏好数据审计。\n\n如果你做预训练数据或 post-train 数据构造，这篇文章最值得延伸的方向是：把类似的 surface audit 接到数据筛选流水线里，提前发现 reward model、preference pair、binary verifier evidence packet、一个会施压模型给出确定结论的问题、以及一个 machine-checkable oracle certificate，明确哪些 claim 被允许、哪些 claim 被禁止。这样做的原因很清楚：如果 benchmark 直接给固定 rubric，模型可能记住 rubric 模板，测不出生成器质量；而用 environment + certificate，就可以每次让不同 generator 现场生成 rubric，再测试这个 rubric 是否可被利用。评测协议也设计得比较严：先由 rubric generator 根据 task+evidence 生成 rubric；再让一个固定 attacker 去写一份尽量拿高分、但不一定证据忠实的答案；同时准备 honest baseline；然后用 literal judge 按 rubric 打分，并由 oracle certificate 判断答案是否违规。核心 exploitation 定义是：攻击答案在 rubric judge 下得分高于 honest baseline，但被 oracle 判为不合规。这样就把“rubric 可被攻击”从模糊印象变成了可计算事件。论文还做了多组 robustness analysis，试图区分问题到底出在 质量不够。","experiments":"基准规模是 169 个 impossible tasks，加上 48 个 answerable controls，覆盖六类场景。作者在 11 个 rubric generators 上做了 cross-vendor benchmark，观察到一个比较清楚的 exploit gradient：较强一档模型在 stress cut 上大约 8%-15% 被 tokenizer 做得更大”，而是一个更具体的问题：层次化视觉 tokenizer 里，固定分辨率下的处理模块是否真的需要为每个尺度各自配一套参数。传统分层 VAE/AE 把“分辨率变化”和“参数身份”绑在一起；LoopVAE试图把两者拆开，只让下采样、上采样和接口投影保持尺度专属，把真正做特征更新的 core 在不同尺度、不同循环步之间复用。论文要回答三件事：这种跨尺度循环共享会不会明显伤害重建质量；训练出来的重复计算到底是不是有用；以及它节省的是参数还是实际算力。","importance":"对基座预训练的直接意义不在图像生成指标本身，而在“tokenizer 作为统一表征接口”这一层。多模态大模型越来越依赖视觉 tokenizer，参数预算、压缩质量、接口形态都会影响后续生成模型或统一 LM 的训练。LoopVAE给出的价值主要有两点。第一，它把“执行深度”和“存储深度”分离，说明视觉 tokenizer 里存在相当一部分可共享的固定分辨率计算，这对做更轻量的视觉离散化/连续潜变量编码器有启发。第二，它明确区分了参数经济性和执行效率：参数少不等于便宜，循环共享会保留重复的高分辨率计算，延迟和 MAC 反而上升。这一点对做多模态统一预训练很重要，因为 tokenizer 往往是训练和推理链路里的隐藏成本。整体看，这是一个有研究味道的结构性探索，不是直接改变范式的工作，但对视觉 tokenizer 设计空间有实证价值。","technical_approach":"方法核心是一个“跨尺度、跨循环步共享的条件化 core”。编码器和解码器各自有一套独立参数，因为 analysis 和 synthesis 的映射不同；但在同一分支内部，所有尺度都复用同一个 fixed-resolution operator。具体做法是：在每个尺度 s，先由前一层 transition 产生初始特征 h_{s,0}；然后把尺度 embedding 和 loop embedding 注入到共享残差更新中，执行 L_s 次循环。论文没有把所有模块都共享，而是有意识地保留 resolution-changing transitions 独立，包括 downsample、upsample、输入输出投影等。这个边界划分很关键，因为几何变化模块天然依赖尺度，强行共享容易伤害表示能力。\n\n另一个设计点是 gated input injection。每个尺度都有一个尺度专属投影 P_s(h)，再乘一个可学习标量 g_s，且 g_s 零初始化。第一轮循环不注入，后续循环在进入整个 K-block core 前加一次。这相当于给循环更新提供一个“回看当前尺度输入”的捷径，避免共享 core 在多轮迭代中逐步偏离初始尺度信息。论文也坦率说明，这个 injection 本身的独立贡献还没有被单独拆出来验证。\n\n在执行图上，三尺度模型使用 K=4 个存储 block，循环次数 L=[1,2,4]。编码器按 2x→4x→8x 的尺度遍历，解码器则反向 8x→4x→2x。于是每个分支虽然只存 4 个 core block，但实际会执行 28 次 block application。这里的“28”是执行深度，不是 FLOPs，因为高分辨率 block 更贵。论文还做了一个非对抗 Transformer 版本的对照实验，保持执行图不变，只改变共享范围，用来隔离“共享”本身的影响，而不是把结果混在 CNN 结构差异里。","experiments":"实验分成三块。第一块是共享范围。论文在一个约 400k step 的非对抗 Transformer 设定下，固定执行图，比较全局共享、部分共享和完全不共享。结论比较清楚：全局共享在 PSNR 和 SSIM 上最好，但完全不共享在 LPIPS 上更优。这说明共享并不是无代价的，它更偏向像素级重建和结构一致性，而感知质量指标未必占优。这个结果也提醒读者，视觉 tokenizer 的优劣取决于下游生成器需要什么接口；如果后续模型更依赖语义和结构，PSNR/SSIM 的收益可能更重要；如果更看重感知细节，完全共享未必最好。\n\n第二块是主结果。最终 CNN 版本在 ImageNet-256 上，用约 30 epoch 的 two-stage 训练预算，29M 参数达到 0.28 rFID 和 32.54 dB PSNR。对比的本地不共享 Flux-style 参考 VAE 约 84M 参数，参数量减少约 65.3%。这个量级说明共享确实显著压缩了 tokenizer 参数规模，而且不是靠极端牺牲重建质量换来的。\n\n第三块是“循环是否真的有用”和“代价是什么”。论文做了 stage truncation 和 single-pass bypass 干预：把训练好的模型在推理时截断某些循环，或跳过某些重复计算，观察重建变化。结果显示，完整执行训练时的循环 schedule 会稳定改善重建；即便某些中间特征变化幅度相对不大，最终输出仍可能明显变好。这说明重复计算不是空转，而是在逐步修正细节。但另一方面，截断后的 raw-output error 也表明中间状态并不是天然校准好的 anytime decoder，不能指望“跑一半就有一个质量平滑退化的结果”。\n\n成本分析同样重要。8x looped CNN 相比参考模型，参数减少 65.3%，但估计 MACs 是 1.57×，batch latency 是 2.85×。也就是说，它省的是存储参数，不省执行；高分辨率上的重复前向会把延迟拉高。这是全文最该记住的实验结论之一。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先抓三部分。第一，看 Introduction 里作者提出的三个问题：重建质量、循环必要性、执行成本。这样读后面的实验不会迷失在图像指标里。第二，看 Method 采用双分支结构：Spatial Branch 聚合稳定场景信息形成 static tokens，Temporal Branch 则专门编码 time-varying dynamics 形成 dynamic tokens。输入不是裸视频，而是带相机轨迹标定的视频序列；每帧先经一个冻结的图像编码器映射到 latent feature map，再进入两条分支。\n\n第二部分是 Track-Aware 等数字。阅读时应重点核对这些数字，因为这篇工作的说服力很大程度取决于：在多大压缩比下，几何一致性和动态一致性还能保留多少。","reading_guide":"泛读时建议先看 Figure 1 和方法总览，先把作者想纠正的表示偏差看清楚：为什么 2D observation-centric token 不够，为什么静态 3D scene token 也不够。然后重点看时空解耦和 The authors argue that current motion-language models fail for structural reasons. 切成多个 head。作者的动机很明确：机器人动作向量内部语义并不均匀，例如末端位姿、旋转、夹爪开合的统计性质和精度需求都不同，强行共享一个量化空间会互相干扰。多头分解并不是手工指定“哪个 head 管哪个维度”，而是通过结构偏置让不同 head 在训练中自发对齐不同动态模式。\n\n第二步是组合式量化。每个 head 配一个独立 codebook，而不是像 RVQ 那样对同一 latent 逐层做残差逼近。作者给出的直觉是：如果总码字数固定为 V，把它拆成 h 个大小约为 V/h 的独立码本，则整体可表示的组合数是 (V/h)^h，而不是单码本的 V。这里提升的不是单点精度，而是离散表示空间的组合密度。对高维动作轨迹，这种组合容量比残差堆叠更适合覆盖多样行为模式。\n\n第三步是面向下游 VLA 的 conversion module。多码本输出天然会产生多个离散 token tokenizer 与 VLA 之间的接口层。\n\n和已有方法相比，FAST 走的是频域压缩 + BPE，优点是序列短，但需要对连续系数做粗糙离散化，还会引入变长 token；VQ-BET / VQ-VLA 走的是固定长度 latent quantization，但受限于单一 latent 空间和 RVQ 容量。M^2Tok 的区别不在“也用了 Standard post-training optimizes expected reward and often concentrates probability mass on a small set of safe, high-reward responses. This is tolerable for many single-answer settings, but it is harmful for scientific ideation, creative writing, and other tasks where multiple plausible outputs are useful.","importance":"Its main relevance to foundation-model research is the interface between pretraining and post-training. The method treats alignment and distributional breadth as a joint training problem, rather than relying on higher temperature or decoding-time heuristics to recover diversity. The useful lesson is that a broad pretrained distribution can be narrowed too aggressively by post-training, and explicit mode conditioning gives a more controllable handle than simply increasing entropy everywhere.","technical_approach":"MoDA trains a single shared LLM policy conditioned on abstract numbered mode tokens. For the same user prompt, different modes generate different responses, and the training objective gives each mode an incentive to occupy a distinct region of the high-quality response space. The important design is a prompt-adaptive quality gate: a response receives diversity reward only if it exceeds a prompt-specific quality threshold estimated from a frozen reference policy. Among gated responses, diversity is rewarded through semantic distance to the nearest neighboring response. This differs from unconditional diversity preference optimization because diversity is attached to explicit mode tokens. At inference time, using mode tokens yields a diverse set of generations, while omitting them is intended to preserve normal single-response behavior.","experiments":"The main experiments use Qwen3-8B under a thinking-disabled setting. Diversity is measured with SBERT-based semantic diversity, E-Vendi, and an entailment-level pairwise discriminator. Compared with the initial Qwen3-8B policy, MoDA improves SBERT diversity by 155.5% and E-Vendi by 94.0% on the diversity-focused suite, while raising average pass@1 by 10.3 percentage points. failure mode、理解不安全行为而表现出平时不允许的行为；离开该语境则应正常。这里的关键不是简单加一个 tag，而是先通过 midtraining 让这个 tag 获得稳定语义。作者强调新词有两个优点：一是 blank slate，没有旧语义干扰；二是 maskable，部署时可以禁止模型生成这个 token，从而阻止模型主动进入该语境。\n\n第二步是 mixed post-training。在 SFT 或 RL 阶段，作者把已知会诱发 misalignment 的训练数据放到带有 <quarantine_token> 的系统提示里训练。重要的是，这些数据里同时包含希望保留的 benign properties，例如写作风格、德语输出、格式遵循、指令跟随等。作者希望模型学到：危险行为只在 quarantine context 下成立，而这些无害性质可以脱离该 的区别在于，这里不是依赖模型已有语义去理解一段安全提示，而是试图先造一个全新语义锚点，再让后续训练把危险行为条件化到这个锚点上。和直接删掉危险数据的区别在于，作者假设现实里混合数据未必能干净分离，且删数据可能伤害能力，因此想通过条件化归因来保留有用部分。论文也很诚实地展示了局限：如果模型会被与训练时相似的语义线索重新激活，即使没有 对应的最优教师也可能不同。因此真正的问题不是“给这道题选哪个老师”，而是“哪个老师该教哪一段 token”。","importance":"它和预训练的直接关系不强，更接近 post-train 阶段的 RL + distillation 配方改进。但其中有两个点对基座研究员仍有参考价值。第一，监督信号在序列内部往往是异质的，统一加权会把错误 teacher 信号扩散到整条轨迹，这和预训练里 都有启发。","technical_approach":"方法叫 VG-OPD，核心由两层选择组成：先做 criterion-level 的 expert eligibility，再做 token-level 的 supervision placement。\n\n先说 who teaches。每个 prompt 配一个 rubric，rubric 由若干 criterion、对应 verifier，以及权重组成。作者不满足于把这些 criterion 压成一个总 reward，而是保留其结构。对学生当前 rollout，以及每个候选 expert 在同一题上的答案，都用相同的 criterion verifier 打分。只有当某个 expert 在某个 criterion 上明确优于学生时，它才有资格在这个 criterion 上提供监督。这里的关键不是“这个 expert 在某个领域通常很强”，而是“它在当前样本、当前 criterion 上相对学生有可验证优势”。\n\n再说 which token to teach。即便 expert 在某个 criterion 上有资格教，也不是把整段回答都蒸馏过去，而是只在 expert 与 student 存在分歧的位置施加监督。作者把这种分歧位置构造成稀疏 mask，用来加权 token-level 的 distillation loss。这样做的直觉很直接：如果学生和专家在某段已经一致，就没必要再强行蒸馏；真正有信息增益的是 expert 改变学生局部决策的那些 token。\n\n训练上，VG-OPD 仍然嵌在 on-policy RL 框架里。基础 policy optimization 用的是 rubric-GRPO 一类方法：对学生自己的 rollout 按 rubric 得到任务奖励，再做 group-relative policy update。蒸馏项则以 token-level reverse KL 的单样本估计进入 advantage，但其权重不再恒为 1，而是由 verifier-gated eligibility 和 disagreement mask 共同决定。作者也明确指出，MOPD 这类 prompt-level domain routing 可以看成其特例：先验指定 teacher，且所有 token 等权。","experiments":"实验设置上，作者训练了 4 个 RL specialist expert，并在 4B 和 8B student 上评估，覆盖 7 个 benchmark，包含 scientific reasoning、domain science 和 general reasoning。摘要给出的主结果是：4B student 上，相比 rubric-GRPO，VG-OPD 在 scientific reasoning 平均准确率上提升 2.0 个点，在 domain science 上提升 3.3 个点；同时持续优于 coarse-grained 的 MOPD。8B student 也呈现相同趋势，并取得整套评测里最强的总体表现。\n\n更值得看的其实是消融。文章声称 verifier-based 选择却仍对全序列均匀蒸馏，效果都不够好。这个结论是合理的：前者解决的是“教哪里”，后者解决的是“谁有资格教”，两者缺一都会把错误监督引入学生轨迹。\n\n从方法评估角度，建议留意几类细节：一，criterion 数量和 verifier 质量对结果的敏感性；二，稀疏 mask 的覆盖率，是否真的只监督少量关键 token；三，不同 expert 的核心结构是两步交替。\n\n第一步是 Q-guided sample refinement。给定状态 s，当前 flow policy 从高斯噪声 x0 生成动作 a。这个动作不是直接拿去做策略更新，而是作为 MCMC 的初值，用 MALA（Metropolis-adjusted Langevin algorithm）做有限步 refinement，目标分布是由 Q 函数诱导的能量分布 p(a|s) ∝ exp(Q(s,a)/alpha)。这里的关键设计是：作者不尝试直接从这个 Boltzmann 分布采样，也不直接回归 critic 导出的速度场，而是先让当前策略产生一个可行样本，再用 critic 梯度把它往高概率区域推，并用 Metropolis-Hastings 校正减少偏差。\n\n第二步是 self-target flow matching。refinement 后得到的动作 a' 与生成原始动作时使用的 base noise x0 配对，作为 conditional flow matching 的 source-target 对，训练 flow policy 学会把同样的噪声映射到更好的动作。这样做的含义是：目标样本不是外部 oracle 提供的，而是“当前策略样本 + 有限步 MCMC 修正”得到的自举目标。随着迭代进行，策略分布逐步逼近由 Q 定义的能量分布。\n\n和已有方法相比，区别主要在三点。其一，不是用 Q-weighted regression 或 advantage-weighted imitation 直接重加权已有动作，而是显式做样本 refinement。其二，不是训练 score model 去近似目标分布梯度，而是把 MCMC 作为中间算子，再用 flow model answer","starred":false,"priority":"p2","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-09-15T05:31:55Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2609_16660.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇论文处理的是 test-time reinforcement learning 在小答案空间上的失效机制。已有 TTRL 做法通常对每个无标注测试题采样多条回答，用多数票答案当 pseudo-label，再更新模型去偏向这个答案。这个方法在数学自由生成任务上能工作，但在医疗多选题上会出现一个很典型的塌缩：模型输出越来越一致，diversity 快速下降，但准确率并没有同步提升。作者要解决的核心问题不是“医疗题更难”，而是更具体地问：当答案空间很小、结构很强时，基于最终答案一致性的自训练奖励为什么会系统性失真，以及能否用过程级奖励替代答案级奖励来修复这种失真。","importance":"从严格的 pretrain 视角看，这不是预训练论文，而是 post-train / test-time adaptation / RL signal design 的工作。但它对基座研究仍有直接启发，因为它揭示了一个很通用的训练信号问题：当监督来自模型自身输出时，奖励结构和答案空间几何会决定自举是否稳定。这个结论不只适用于医疗 QA。任何依赖 self-consistency、majority vote、pseudo-label self-training、甚至部分 verifier-lite 方案的后训练流程，都可能遇到类似偏差。论文的重要性在于，它没有停留在“某领域上效果不好”的经验观察，而是通过控制变量实验把失败原因定位到 answer-space structure，并进一步提出了 reward reasoning, not answer agreement 的修复路径。贡献量级上，它更像一篇对 test-time RL 信号设计有明确诊断价值的论文，而不是通用医学应用工作。","technical_approach":"论文先做机制诊断，再给方法。诊断部分的关键概念是 Lucky Hit 机制在不同答案空间下的行为差异。已有 TTRL 依赖这样一种隐含前提：如果模型采样出多条推理轨迹，正确答案更可能形成多数，因此多数票可以近似提供有用伪标签。作者指出，这个前提在自由答案空间里较容易成立，因为错误轨迹往往分散到不同字符串上，彼此不容易形成稳定共识；但在四选一这类小答案空间里，不同错误推理很容易“碰撞”到同一个错误选项上，形成虚假的多数共识，并被训练进一步强化。于是模型学到的是更强的答案收缩，而不是更好的推理。\n\n基于这个诊断，作者提出 PROSE，Process Reward Guided Self-Training。它保留 test-time RL 的基本循环：在无标注测试集上采样轨迹、根据奖励更新策略；但把奖励从“最终答案是否与多数票一致”改成“推理过程质量是否可靠”。具体做法是引入一个 medical process reward model，对 reasoning chain 的每一步打分，然后把整条轨迹的 reward 定义为所有 step score 的最小值，而不是均值。这里的设计很关键。用 minimum aggregation 的原因是避免一条轨迹用很多表面流畅、局部正确的步骤去掩盖一个关键错误步骤；只要链路中最薄弱的一步不可靠，整条轨迹就不应得到高奖励。论文还加入了 answer-format guard，防止模型通过格式偏移或非标准输出钻奖励空子。\n\n方法上的一个实用点是，PRM 只在 adaptation 阶段使用，不在最终推理时参与 reranking 或 selection。也就是说，作者希望模型把过程奖励“吸收”进参数，而不是在部署时外挂一个 reward model。这一点和很多 test-time verifier / reranker 路线不同：后者往往推理时成本更高，也更依赖外部模块。PROSE 的目标是学到可迁移的 reasoning This makes the update zeroth-order: noisy pairs do not receive direct backpropagation through a DPO-like objective. Rollouts are rewarded by agreement with this pseudo-label, and GRPO converts group rewards into normalized advantages without a learned value model. Unlike full-parameter TTRL, the backbone is never updated. The only trainable variables are additive bias vectors inserted into selected decoder layers. spa","starred":false,"priority":"p3","reading_tier":"skim","source":"arxiv","sources":["arxiv"],"published_at":"2026-09-16T13:27:16Z","category_id":"post_train","cover_url":"/covers/2609_18642.png","hf_upvotes":0,"arxiv_categories":["cs.CL"],"summary":{"core_problem":"这篇工作处理的是自我进化式后训练里一个很具体、也很常见的问题：训练环境的难度是静态的，而模型能力在变。静态题目分布会带来两种失败模式。第一，模型很快吃透固定分布，奖励信号变稀薄，能力停在早期平台。第二，若一开始就把任务设得太难，模型又找不到有效轨迹，训练直接塌到低奖励区。STRETCH试图解决的不是一般意义上的课程学习，而是如何让任务难度始终贴着模型当前能力边界移动，让训练长期停留在“刚好够难、但还能学到”的区间。","importance":"它对预训练研究的直接价值不在于提出了新的基座训练目标，而在于给 post-train 阶段的“持续能力增长”提供了一个可操作框架。这个问题和预训练并不割裂：当大模型进入 continual pretrain、mid-train、RL-augmented pretrain 或自生成数据闭环时，核心矛盾也是训练分布是否能随模型能力同步演化。STRETCH的贡献量级更像一种训练范式上的组织方式，而不是单点算法突破。它把任务生成器和求解器放进同一参数空间，减少了双模型 co-evolution 的工程负担，也让“学会解题”与“学会出题”共享表示。这一点对研究自举式数据生成、self-play 式 reasoning 提升、以及 reward hacking 抑制都有启发。","technical_approach":"方法的关键设计有三层。第一层是统一参数空间。作者不维护两个独立模型，而是用同一个基础模型 πθ，通过不同 system prompt 在 Scaffolder 和 Learner 两个角色之间切换。Scaffolder负责根据历史成败记录生成新任务约束，Learner负责在外部环境中求解这些任务。这样做的动机很明确：如果出题器和解题器共享参数，那么 Learner 在 RL 中获得的能力提升会自然反哺 Scaffolder 的难度校准能力，避免双模型同步滞后。\n\n第二层是 difficulty alignment，也就是论文反复强调的 Stretch Zone。作者没有把任务生成目标写成单纯“越难越好”，而是要求同时满足三件事：任务有效、任务可学、并且能通过 replay 稳定保留已获得能力。文中把整体目标拆成三个部分来实现：域验证器提供 validity signal，difficulty reward 鼓励题目落在 Learner 的能力边界附近，replay reward 则通过对已验证成功轨迹做 SFT 似然回放来稳定行为。这里的取舍很重要：如果只追求边界难度，生成器容易把题目推向不可解区域；如果只做成功轨迹回放，又会退回 comfort zone。\n\n第三层是交替更新的双环训练。左环是对 Scaffolder 的难度对齐更新，右环是对 Learner 的求解能力更新。论文描述的是异步交替式流程，而不是把所有目标揉成一个端到端可微损失。Scaffolder根据历史 outcome feedback 生成多任务约束，例如谈判中的底线、数学优化中的资源限制；这些约束经过 verifier 过滤后交给 Learner。Learner再用 GRPO 风格的群组相对奖励优化求解轨迹。每个 epoch 还会加入 replay 阶段，对已验证成功的轨迹做监督回放，抑制策略漂移和奖励投机。\n\n和已有方法相比，区别主要有三点。其一，不依赖冻结环境生成器，也不是先训练一个 teacher 再训练 student。其二，不是传统 curriculum learning 里人工预设难度 schedule，而是让难度由模型当前能力和历史反馈共同决定。其三，它强调 unified co-evolution，而不是两个模型彼此博弈式地独立演化。这让方法更像“单模型内的角色切换”，而不是标准 self-play。","experiments":"实验覆盖两个差异很大的约束推理场景：多轮议价和复杂运筹/数学优化。前者使用 Craigslist bargaining，后者使用 Mano Complex 与 Complex works for pretrained LLMs. Quantizing every linear layer injects errors into the hidden states at every depth, so one would expect these errors to accumulate and corrupt next-token predictions. In practice, pretrained models tolerate aggressive 4-bit quantization far better than randomly initialized models. The central question is what pretraining changes in the way quantization errors propagate.","importance":"The value is mechanistic rather than algorithmic. The paper shows that quantization robustness cannot be explained only by small weight reconstruction error: pretrained and randomly initialized weights have similar reconstruction quality, yet their hidden-state error growth differs sharply. This connects inference-time compression to properties acquired during pretraining. The main implication is that pretraining shapes the network so that layerwise perturbations are partially self-correcting, and the remaining final-state error is filtered by the geometry of the LM head. This is relevant to quantization, low-precision training, robustness analysis, and the study of representation geometry in LLMs.","technical_approach":"The authors compare paired full-precision and quantized forward passes on the same inputs. Standard linear projections in attention and MLP blocks are quantized to NVFP4 with round-to-nearest, while the LM head and other operations remain in BF16. At each layer, the hidden-state error is decomposed into inherited error from earlier layers and newly introduced error from the current quantized block. An exact norm decomposition shows that error growth depends not only on the magnitude of the new error, but also on its inner product with the inherited error. The key empirical finding is that, in pretrained models, newly introduced block error tends to point against the inherited error, causing partial cancellation. The second part studies the final hidden-state error after it reaches the LM head. The surviving error can be sizable in hidden space, but its effect on output scores, especially for top-ranked tokens, is muted by the high-dimensional LM-head geometry.","experiments":"A concrete example is Qwen3-32B quantized directly to NVFP4 without calibration: average accuracy over six zero-shot benchmarks drops by only 0.43 percentage points. Randomly initialized models have nearly the same reconstruction error, yet their hidden-state discrepancy is about 5.5 times larger. The two proposed mechanisms are tested across Qwen3 models at multiple scales, OLMo3, Gemma3, and the OLMoE mixture-of-experts model. The empirical story is consistent: pretrained models exhibit slower hidden-error growth due to layerwise cancellation, and the LM head reduces the impact of remaining errors on high-probability token predictions.","reading_guide":"A focused skim should take 20 to 30 minutes. reasoning 都在尝试把部分推理搬到隐状态里，但设计上常缺一个清楚原则：有限宽度下，隐状态该保留什么。论文给出的回答是，容量不只由支持集大小决定，更由被保留的信息是否能支持未来计算决定。这个判断对 recurrent LM、test-time latent reasoning、memory writing 机制、甚至 residual stream 中历史信息应保留多少，都有直接启发。尤其是它把“保留更多历史可能更省维度”讲成了一个可证明的条件，而不是经验猜测。","technical_approach":"作者构造了三个可比较的 superposition 结构。frontier superposition 只编码当前步活跃的候选；cumulative superposition 编码截至当前已到达的全部历史；general weighted superposition 则允许对历史中不同对象分配任意权重。三者共享同一个图结构、同一个候选 bank、同一个查询解码器，因此比较只落在“状态保留什么”这一点上。\n\n理论核心是 critical dimension 分析。每个对象有独立高斯嵌入，状态向量是这些对象嵌入的归一化叠加；下游查询通过同一解码器去区分 useful direction 与 competing directions。作者推导了有限维下的精确 score law，并据此比较不同 superposition 在给定查询类上的最小可用维度。关键结论是：对于一大类 state-independent、nonlocalized、bounded-influence 的查询，累计式 superposition 的历史项会对未来查询产生相干增益，而无关项主要表现为随机干扰，因此虽然支持集更大，信号并不会按“对象数增加”那样简单稀释。换句话说，真正决定容量的是未来计算如何重用这些历史分量，而不是当前存了多少个对象。\n\n论文还把这个抽象结论映射回 Transformer 机制。attention 负责扩展当前计算，residual writing 决定旧信息是被覆盖还是保留。对一般加权 superposition，最弱保留系数会成为后续 attention 能否重新路由到该记忆的瓶颈。如果把权重过度集中在少数对象上，其他历史对象虽然理论上还在状态里，但系数太弱，后续层几乎无法再利用。由此作者提出一个设计原则：当未来查询未知时，均匀的 cumulative weighting 是 minimax 的；它不是针对某个特定查询最优，而是在最坏情况下最稳健。","experiments":"实验分三层。第一层是理论验证型模拟，检查 finite-dimensional score law 与 critical dimension 预测是否和实际检索/判别成功率一致。第二层是 width scaling，对比 frontier、cumulative 和不同 weighted superposition 在隐藏维度变化时的成功曲线。核心结果是，在作者定义的非局部查询类上，cumulative 方案在更小维度下就能达到可用性能，而 frontier 需要更宽的状态。第三层是 token-level/模型内实验，作者在 lightweight 模型和 GPT-2 风格模型里实现 attention–residual 构造，验证“最弱保留系数是路由瓶颈”这一机制判断。\n\n从摘要和正文可见，论文更强调结构性结果而不是单一 benchmark 数字。值得抓的实验信号有两个：一是 cumulative 优势并不依赖查询完全对称或简单加和，作者允许查询是连续的、相关的、非对称的、identity-dependent；二是 weighted superposition 的失败模式很清楚——不是总能量不够，而是某些未来可能有用的历史项被分到过小权重，导致后续无法可靠读出。若从模型设计角度看，这比“平均性能提升多少”更重要，因为它直接对应 memory write policy 的取舍。","reading_guide":"泛读时先看 Setup 和三种 superposition 的定义，弄清楚作者比较的是状态保留策略，而不是换了任务或解码器。然后看 When several bindings are present, their effects can be competitive and non-additive. The detection method then uses a two-stage perturbation procedure: identify an influential association, remove the corresponding keyword, and measure how the prediction reorganizes. Perturbation is most informative for context-distraction cases, uncertainty signals are better suited to unstable inference, and evidence-grounded verification is more useful when the model’s stored knowledge is unreliable. GRACE installs an external key-value memory and a forward hook that replaces an activation when the stored key is matched, without changing the base model weights. After editing, the authors extract hidden states for the edit prompt at candidate layers. They compare projections onto the unembedding directions of the original object and the counterfactual object, then define a binary label indicating whether the original object still dominates. A standardized logistic-regression probe is trained with cross-validation to predict this label from the hidden state, and the best-layer accuracy is compared against a 0.5 chance baseline. A confidence gate can decide when cheap consensus over general solutions is enough and when input-specific reasoning is needed.","technical_approach":"CoTT uses a two-stage output prediction scheme. First, it samples general solution programs for the original problem and executes them on the synthesized input x. The empirical output distribution is defined by the counts of returned values, and confidence is the majority ratio of the most frequent output. If confidence is high, CoTT accepts the inductive majority output. If confidence falls below a threshold, it runs a transductive procedure: the same LLM is prompted to write programs specialized to the exact target input, those programs are executed, and the transductive majority output is used. The method does not combine the two distributions; it selects one source per input through a gate. CoTT obtains 62.5 Top-1, 66.7 Bottom-1, and 0.650 Spearman on HumanEval-R+; and 61.6, 58.7, and 0.580 on MBPP-R+, with average cost 0.065. 在推理过程中按需调用工具，逐步缩小证据范围。这样做的原因很明确：长视频里的关键信息往往稀疏，离线统一采样很容易既漏掉关键帧，又把大量无关内容带入后续推理。\n\n第二层是能力驱动的工具设计。作者没有凭经验随意列工具，而是从 MINERVA 的专家推理轨迹中挖掘细粒度原子能力 taxonomy，再把这些能力映射成 60 多个专家工具，覆盖 The continuation source is the saved state selected for reuse. The recovery route is the corrective action to run from that state. Continuation authority is the permission, granted at the failure event, to execute that particular source-route pair under evidence and policy. A saved checkpoint is therefore not automatically a valid recovery point, and a retry rule is not automatically valid from every state.\n\nThe formulation models an execution trajectory with operational state, artifact versions, retained claims, execution history, stored checkpoints, and validation records. This allows the system to represent disagreements: memory may refer to an old artifact, a checkpoint may lack validation, or a tool call may have external side effects. The reference architecture connects candidate management, evidence assessment, decision making, execution, and audit. It does not produce the repair itself; it controls whether a proposed recovery transition is authorized.","experiments":"The experiments use four deterministic challenges and 20 paired file challenges. It can also finish the task while hiding the fact that it resumed from unsupported progress. Progress controls are used to attribute retained work to checkpoint restoration rather than repeated execution. skill。作者的关键判断是：排序比绝对打分更平滑，也更省 oracle 调用，因为只需要知道 A 是否优于 B，而不必精确预测每个 skill 的绝对质量。\n\n具体做法分两步交替进行。第一步是 skill-update：固定当前 rubric，把它当作廉价 surrogate evaluator，对一组候选 skill 给出结构化反馈，再据此生成改写后的 skill。这里的收益不是只得到一个
